svg.title: Control systems engineer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as control systems engineer, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A round indicating gauge and a rectangular control block connect through a returning feedback line. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face and round glasses.
